Red Line Impact Model (RLIM)

v0.2.0

Cadastral data warehouse, spatial feature engineering, and quasi-experimental econometric models evaluating transit capitalization and displacement risk across Mecklenburg County rail corridors.

bronze.parcels — Mecklenburg County Tax Parcels (Bronze)

Raw cadastral parcel boundaries ingested from gis.charlottenc.gov CountyData MapServer.

Econometric Model Output Summary
ModelSpecificationDependent VariableEstimatorCoefStd. Err (HC1)p-valueImplied Impact
Model 1 Hedonic OLS Gradient ln(Real PPSF) Distance to Station (per km) -0.1165 0.0016 < 0.0001 -10.99% / km
Model 2 Quasi-Experimental DiD ln(Real PPSF) Treated × Post (2018+) +0.0025 0.0290 0.9311 +0.25% (p = 0.93)
Identification Strategy: Model 1 confirms a steep spatial rent gradient across Mecklenburg County (~11% discount per km from rail platforms). Model 2 identifies the operational opening shock of the LYNX Blue Line Extension relative to the unbuilt Matthews control corridor. The insignificant post-opening coefficient corroborates the anticipatory capitalization hypothesis: transit premiums were largely capitalized during land assembly and construction (2014–2017) before revenue service commenced.
